_comment: Maps PilotDef.voiceKey labels to ElevenLabs voice ids. At runtime tools/voice/generate.ts fetches GET /v1/voices and, when a label has 'voiceName', looks up the current id for that name (voice ids can be regenerated on ElevenLabs's side; names are stable). The 'voiceId' field is the hardcoded fallback used if that lookup fails or the label has no voiceName. Unknown labels fall back to heuristics in generate.ts (gender/tone keywords), then to 'default'.
